scope: Controlled source/VM production cancellation checks only. Native cancellation/refunds are source-inspected and compiled, not executed; no emulator or native runtime.
checks: Stale job, template, start time and wrong factory identity cannot reach native cancellation
Unknown native queue or rejected native identity leaves the current job and FIFO intact
Acknowledged exact cancellation preserves other factories and waiting entries; ordinary FIFO advances and old repeated tap cannot cancel the next unit
Group cancellation removes only exact still-waiting IDs, retaining a promoted unit and other factories
Queue exposes compact current, one-waiting and waiting-group controls with busy guard, acknowledgement and fresh snapshot refresh; UI JavaScript parses
Compiled native hook source gates Towers/player and exact subject, rejects pending/internal runs, and delegates refunds to existing native cancellation
